title: Hero's Immersive VR
description: This project makes for a perfect, vanilla friendly, VR Co-Op survival experience.
body:
This modpack is intended to be the perfect vanilla-friendly immersive optimized experience, with full VR support. It has many QoL features, and makes for the perfect Co-Op gameplay! It makes the game much more difficult, with all sorts of great features such as a revamped end and nether, plenty of revamped structures, and Co-Op features such as being downed instead of killed! Uhh so yeah, it's very cool and stuff, please download if you want the perfect vanilla vr experience -w-. This is the Questcraft version, install the PC version if you aren't using Quest Craft!
uhh, dm me at 'herothefurryfr' on Discord if you intend to join my server!
